title: Full Stack Engineer (Java/Angular) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Java development;
  • Experience with cloud environments and modern backend systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Experience working with Apache Kafka;
  • Experience with Angular for frontend development;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

title: Data Scientist - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Data Science Seniors to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work together with developers, tech leads and solution architects to build applications.

- Improve existing structures by adding new functionalities or proposing technological updates so that as a result, the impact of your contribution is significant in the core of each business.

- The result of your work will also allow you to improve the user experience on scalable and high availability platforms, contributing to the key differential of each business.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Business Development Representative
description:
WeMaster Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets.


Responsibilities:

• Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives.

• Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies.

• Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform.

• Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue.

• Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.

• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.


Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.

• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).

• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.

• Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage.


What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives

• Ongoing professional development and career growth

• Collaborative and international work environment

• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems


Job Type : Full-Time / Remote

Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets.


Responsibilities:

• Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives.

• Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies.

• Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform.

• Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue.

• Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.

• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.


Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.

• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).

• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.

• Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage.


What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives

• Ongoing professional development and career growth

• Collaborative and international work environment

• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems


Job Type : Full-Time / Remote

Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

title: Social Media Creator
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Social Media Creator with the vision and capability to increase our social following and traffic to our site from various social platforms.


Primary responsibilities:


  • Produce engaging social content relevant to our target audience and our brand
  • Substantially increase social media engagement and follower count
  • Drive traffic to the site


We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.


DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Responsibilities


  • Create a social media strategy and calendar for various social platforms
  • Develop and execute original ideas, scripts, and concepts end-to-end
  • Craft all creatives, including messaging, design, and video
  • Produce content focused on marketing and B2B topics to drive traffic and growth
  • Utilize AI to generate content ideas and help with execution
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Build and engage a professional online community through impactful content
  • Represent the brand consistently and professionally across all platforms
  • Optimize YouTube performance through SEO, thumbnails, and high-retention content
  • Use social trends (sounds, challenges, formats) to expand reach and visibility
  • Track and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve results


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram
  • Proven experience in B2B and/or media environments.
  • Strong copywriting and storytelling skills to produce engaging, on-brand content
  • Proficient in social media tools, analytics, and video editing software
  • Progressive thinker and avid user of AI
  • Passionate about communication, creativity, and making an impact
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST


Recruitment Steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Complete a short questionnaire
  • Submit answers and CV
  • Interview with the Recruitment team
  • Complete a technical test
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager(s)
  • Receive feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 USD


The backend serves both a consumer-facing onboarding app and an internal admin operations dashboard.


Current Backend Stack:

  • GraphQL API server (single endpoint) likely built with NestJS + TypeGraphQL or similar Node.js/TypeScript framework
  • AWS Cognito for user authentication (SRP protocol, email + phone login, token refresh)
  • PostgreSQL database with relational schema (users, payments, vehicle loans, agreements, stage transitions)
  • Hosted on AWS (us-east-1 region)
  • Integrations: Plaid (bank linking), ACH payment processor, KYC/identity verification, PDF generation, e-sign


Backend Responsibilities:

  • 30+ GraphQL queries and 20+ mutations covering user lifecycle, payments, onboarding, and financial reporting
  • Multi-stage onboarding pipeline (11 stages):
  • signup → identity → bank link → cash flow → admin review → approval → micro-deposits → auto loan link → disclosure → payment setup → active
  • Payment scheduling, debt collection, refund processing
  • FBO (For Benefit Of) sub-ledger tracking
  • Credit line management and daily contribution calculations


Required Skills:

  • TypeScript / Node.js primary language
  • GraphQL schema design, resolvers, input validation (NestJS GraphQL module or Apollo Server)
  • PostgreSQL complex queries, migrations, enum types, indexing
  • AWS Cognito (SRP auth protocol), deployment (ECS / Lambda / AppSync)
  • Plaid API Link tokens, bank account verification, micro-deposits
  • ACH / Payment processing understanding of payment lifecycles, failed payment handling, refund flows (currently using Spinwheel.io)


Preferred Experience:

  • Fintech or payments industry background
  • FBO accounting / sub-ledger reconciliation
  • KYC / AML compliance workflows
  • E-sign / digital agreement flows
  • Multi-channel communications (SMS via Twilio, email via Resend)


Scope of Work:

  • Along with our partner, we are seeking someone to quickly modify and rewrite the onboarding process to reduce friction and delays. You will implement new features through the Plaid API and other onboarding processes to eliminate drop-off and improve customer experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build core systems at a fast-growing fintech company.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays



*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.

  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção, com atuação em ágil convencional e ágil escalado.
  • Domínio de Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, métricas ágeis e CI/CD.
  • Capacidade de facilitar cerimônias, orientar times, remover impedimentos, promover padrões ágeis e utilizar indicadores para garantir a qualidade, apoiar ações estratégicas e induzir a evolução e a melhoria contínua.
  • Certificações ágeis são desejáveis.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Especialista em infraestrutura de TI - Temporário
description:
Objetivo do papel no projeto

Estamos em busca de um especialista em Infraestrutura / Data Center com sólida experiência em ambientes corporativos ou bancários, atuando em capacity planning, alta disponibilidade, arquitetura de data centers e continuidade de serviços de TI.

Vivência em ambientes ativo‑ativo, análise de carregamento, storage, virtualização e suporte a testes de contingência.

Atribuições

  • Análise de capacidade atual e futura de:
  • compute (clusters, virtualização, CPU, memória);
  • storage (capacidade, IOPS, latência, replicação);
  • network (largura de banda, latência inter‑DC).
  • Interpretação de métricas históricas e tendências.
  • Elaboração de cenários prospectivos :
  • crescimento orgânico;
  • contingência (DC único absorvendo 100% da carga);
  • iniciativas estratégicas (ex.: IA, aumento de criticidade).
  • Avaliação técnica de: arquitetura físico‑lógica dos Data Center (DCs), modelo ativo‑ativo real , incluindo exceções técnicas e dependências entre sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Análise comparativa de alternativas (enterprise e colocation);
  • Suporte a entregáveis e transferência de conhecimento
  • Contribuição técnica para elaboração de relatórios e parecer técnico.


  • Experiência necessária
  • 5 anos em infraestrutura de TI corporativa ou bancária;
  • Vivência comprovada em Data Centers de médio/grande porte ;
  • Experiência prévia com ambientes ativo‑ativo ou alta disponibilidade e projetos de continuidade ou contingência.


  • Conhecimentos técnicos
  • Virtualização (VMware / Hyper‑V / equivalentes);
  • Storage enterprise (SAN, replicação síncrona/quase síncrona);
  • Networks de alta disponibilidade (LAN/WAN, inter‑DC);
  • Capacidade, performance, latência e gargalos.

Experiência com ambientes em cloud (Azure/AWS), CI/CD e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Clean Code, SOLID, DDD).


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Ciência de Dados & IA
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Desenvolver e implantar fluxos de LLM para o ecossistema ERP Protheus, transformando dados complexos em soluções de negócio escaláveis.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Desenvolvimento de Inteligência Artificial: Criar e implantar fluxos de LLM (Large Language Models) integrados ao ecossistema ERP Protheus;
  • Criação de Agentes Inteligentes: Desenvolver agentes utilizando frameworks avançados como LangGraph e LangChain;
  • Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP): Aplicar tecnologias de NLP, utilizando Hugging Face e técnicas de Embeddings para tratar dados complexos;
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Dado: Atuar em todas as etapas do projeto, desde a coleta e preparação de dados até a efetiva colocação de modelos em produção;
  • Operações de Machine Learning (MLOps): Utilizar ferramentas como Docker e práticas de CI/CD para garantir a escalabilidade e manutenção das soluções;
  • Governança e Qualidade Técnica: Assegurar a qualidade técnica e a governança estatística de todos os modelos implantados;
  • Soluções de Negócio: Transformar dados complexos em soluções de negócio escaláveis que agreguem valor ao ecossistema da empresa;
  • Análise Técnica: Aplicar conhecimentos sólidos em Estatística, Matemática e Modelagem Preditiva para resolver problemas reais;
  • Engenharia de Software: Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo Clean Code e versionamento de código via Git;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Sólida base em Estatística/Matemática, Machine Learning e Modelagem Preditiva;
  • Desenvolver agentes inteligentes (LangGraph / LangChain);
  • Domínio de NLP (Hugging Face / Embeddings), ferramentas de MLOps (Docker / CI/CD);
  • Domínio em SQL e Python (Pandas / BeatifulSoup / NLTK);
  • Prática no ciclo de vida completo do dado: da coleta/preparação à colocação de modelos em
  • produção;


DIFERENCIAL

  • Experiência em GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery);
  • Vivência em projetos fiscais;
  • Conhecimento em Regressão, Classificação, Clustering, Séries Temporais, Redes Neurais;
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica e a governança estatística dos modelos implantados;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software: CleanCode, Versionamento de Código (Git).

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Analista de Negócios Pleno
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO


  • Levantar e documentar requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades e projetos.
  • Redigir histórias de usuários detalhadas, alinhadas às necessidades do cliente interno.
  • Analisar integrações e tecnologias, propondo soluções práticas e escaláveis.
  • Ser o ponto focal para dúvidas sobre processos de desenvolvimento e soluções voltadas para o mercado de seguros.
  • Redesenhar processos existentes, otimizando fluxos e resultados.
  • Identificar e mapear oportunidades de mercado, propondo melhorias estratégicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Experiência no setor de seguros: Vivência em corretoras ou seguradoras.
  • Experiência com Ferramentas do Google Workspace em nível intermediário (Sheets, Docs, etc.).
  • Desejável experiência com Jira e familiaridade com integrações tecnológicas.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, organização e transparência para atuar de forma colaborativa.
  • Ensino superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Conhecimento avançado sobre práticas e tendências do setor de seguros.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ


️ Auxílio Alimentação : para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos.

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais.

Assistência Médica SulAmérica : Cuidado completo para você e sua família.

description:
A Schalter busca um profissional com maturidade comercial, capacidade de negociação, repertório consultivo e foco em performance para atuar na venda de soluções tecnológicas, desde a identificação da oportunidade até o fechamento e expansão da carteira.


Fundada em 1991, a Schalter é referência em soluções completas de autoatendimento e self-checkout, com um ecossistema que inclui hardware, software, implantação, suporte técnico on site, monitoramento remoto, locação e outsourcing. Nosso propósito é ajudar nossos clientes a satisfazer seus próprios clientes, com tecnologia, eficiência e inovação.


Esta posição exige capacidade de diagnóstico comercial, condução de reuniões estratégicas, negociação de propostas e desenvolvimento de contas, em uma operação orientada a resultado.


Responsabilidades

●      Prospectar novos clientes e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio

●      Realizar reuniões e apresentações comerciais

●      Identificar necessidades e dores dos clientes

●      Apresentar soluções tecnológicas aderentes ao cenário de cada conta

●      Elaborar, conduzir e negociar propostas comerciais

●      Fechar vendas e apoiar a expansão da carteira

●      Manter relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders

●      Atualizar CRM, controles e sistemas internos

●      Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas para garantir fluidez no processo comercial

●      Antecipar riscos e sugerir melhorias contínuas na operação comercial

Requisitos

●      Experiência comprovada em vendas e negociação

●      Vivência com atendimento ao cliente e relacionamento comercial

●      Boa comunicação verbal e escrita

●      Capacidade de negociação e condução de fechamento

●      Organização, planejamento e gestão de pipeline comercial

●      Perfil orientado a metas e resultados


Diferenciais

●      Experiência com venda de soluções tecnológicas

●      Conhecimento em produtos de informática

●      Familiaridade com terminais de autoatendimento, self-checkout e softwares aplicativos

●      Formação em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, TI ou áreas afins


Remuneração e condições

●      Salário fixo compatível com formação, experiência e escopo do cargo

●      Remuneração variável/comissão conforme performance

●      Benefícios informados ao longo do processo seletivo, conforme política interna da empresa

●      Jornada presencial, em tempo integral, em Cachoeirinha/RS


Se você quer atuar em uma empresa com proposta de valor robusta, venda consultiva e espaço para geração real de resultado, a Schalter quer conhecer o seu perfil.

title: Analista de Modelagem de Dados
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a modelagem conceitual do domínio em contexto industrial, conectando arquitetura de dados a necessidades de negócio. Será responsável por entender projetos, abstrair processos e estruturar a camada de domínio e os use cases, colaborando com times multifuncionais e globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Conduzir a modelagem conceitual do domínio no contexto industrial, definindo entidades, relacionamentos e limites de contexto.
  • Derivar e estruturar use cases e modelos de domínio com base na arquitetura de dados corporativa.
  • Entender projetos e requisitos, abstrair processos e mapear para a camada de domínio e casos de uso.
  • Assegurar consistência e governança dos modelos, facilitando discussões técnicas com times globais.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em modelagem conceitual de dados e de domínio, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais.
  • Vivência em traduzir arquitetura de dados em modelos de domínio e casos de uso de negócio e técnicos.
  • Forte capacidade de abstração, comunicação e facilitação entre negócio, dados e engenharia.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (participação ativa em reuniões e workshops com times globais).


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Angular FullStack

Nossa estrutura permite participar de projetos globais e proporciona um ambiente colaborativo que nos certifica em GreatPlacesToWork e planos diferenciados para Jovens Profissionais também reconhecidos pela Employers for Youth.


Você atuará no nosso time de Desenvolvimento em um projeto estratégico, utilizando metodologias ágeis e em um ambiente de inovação.

Buscamos profissionais com senso de dono, comprometidos com o sucesso do nosso cliente e com o desenvolvimento da sua carreira dentro da Minsait

Você será um pilar fundamental nos melhores e maiores projetos de TI do Brasil e em nível global.

title: Analista de Negócios (Dados)
description:
Descrição:


• Conduzir estudos quantitativos de negócio de forma autônoma, desde a formulação de hipóteses até a extração de dados, modelagem e geração de recomendações estratégicas;

• Identificar oportunidades de crescimento no canal App por meio de análises estatísticas — correlações, segmentação de clientes, análise de propensão e modelos de regressão aplicados a comportamento de contratação;

• Acompanhar os indicadores de performance do canal digital (funil de conversão, ticket médio, volume de contratos), diagnosticando desvios e propondo ações corretivas com embasamento em dados;

• Contribuir na concepção de novas funcionalidades e jornadas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia com visão orientada a dados;

• Construir e manter dashboards analíticos em Power BI ou ferramentas similares, garantindo visibilidade dos KPIs para a liderança;

• Agir proativamente na identificação e remoção de obstáculos ao desempenho da equipe, trazendo dados como base para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:


• Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Física ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa;

• Experiência comprovada com análise estatística aplicada a negócio: correlação, regressão, testes de hipótese e significância estatística;

• Capacidade de extrair, processar e analisar dados de forma autônoma, sem dependência de time de dados dedicado;

• Domínio de SQL para consultas analíticas (incluindo joins complexos, agregações e subqueries);

• Conhecimento em Power BI e Excel avançado (modelagem de dados, DAX, tabelas dinâmicas, análises estatísticas);

• Experiência prévia em setor financeiro ou bancário, com compreensão de produtos de crédito, canais digitais ou comportamento do cliente em apps.


Desejáveis:


• Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados e modelagem estatística;

• Conhecimento em Snowflake, BigQuery ou outro data warehouse moderno;

• Vivência com testes A/B — incluindo definição de significância estatística, tamanho de amostra e interpretação dos resultados;

• Atuação prévia com canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

  • We are seeking a high-caliber Senior Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead strategic initiatives within the Life Sciences domain.

  • The ideal candidate will possess a decade of experience driving digital transformation through robust data management strategies.


Desirable Skills:

  • 8+ years in Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals/Consumer Health).
  • Technical: Advanced mastery of Product Information Management (PIM), Master Data Management (MDM), and global data syndication tools.
